say:3:1410532001:1.text: Can we slow down a bit? My feet are killing me...
say:3:1410532001:1.source_cn: 能不能慢一点走？我的脚好疼……

say:4:1410532002:1.text: Sure, but honestly, aren't you a little too weak for your age? We've barely taken a few steps! Back when I was your age...
say:4:1410532002:1.source_cn: 行，我们慢点儿。不是我说，你的体力也太差了，这才走了几步。

say:6:1410532004:1.text: What is it? Don't tell me you just choked on air.
say:6:1410532004:1.source_cn: 怎么了？被自己的口水呛到了？

say:8:1410532006:1.text: WHOA! Are you alright?! You look awful!
say:8:1410532006:1.source_cn: 你没事吧？你的脸色好差！

say:9:1410532007:1.text: I want to say I'm fine... but I feel terrible...
say:9:1410532007:1.source_cn: 我想说我没事……但我……好难受……

say:10:1410532008:1.text: Why did he suddenly collapse like this?
say:10:1410532008:1.source_cn: 这孩子突然之间怎么了？

say:11:1410532009:1.text: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
say:11:1410532009:1.male: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
say:11:1410532009:1.female: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?

choice_prompt:12:1410532009.text: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.source_cn: 他这个状态……<style=stress><player_name></style>，还记得咱们第一次前往萨洛克兰的路上，有个艾塞勒向咱们求救的事吗？！
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.male: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.female: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?

say:13:1410532010:1.text: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.
say:13:1410532010:1.source_cn: 对！当时那个艾塞勒的症状也一样，咳嗽不止，身体疼痛！
say:13:1410532010:1.male: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.
say:13:1410532010:1.female: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.

say:14:1410532011:1.text: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!
say:14:1410532011:1.source_cn: 我记得他叫阿利多……艾塞勒管他们这个叫什么来着……哦对...
say:14:1410532011:1.male: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!
say:14:1410532011:1.female: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!

say:15:1410532013:1.text: No... no way. I took my Divine Dew on time today—there's no way I could be transforming...
say:15:1410532013:1.source_cn: 不……不可能，我今天按时享用了恩典灵露，怎么可能会孽化……

say:16:1410532014:1.text: I should be fine... *Cough* Maybe I'm just not used to this new environment yet... Don't worry about me, let's keep moving.
say:16:1410532014:1.source_cn: 我、我没事……咳咳！可能是一急之下呛到了。我能忍受，我...

say:17:1410532015:1.text: I think you should go back for your own safety.
say:17:1410532015:1.source_cn: 别逞能了，为了你的安全考虑，你要不留在这里？别去地面了！

say:18:1410532016:1.text: I'm starting to think you Essail might be allergic to the surface air...
say:18:1410532016:1.source_cn: 我甚至怀疑，你们艾塞勒是不是对地面的空气过敏……

say:19:1410532017:1.text: No! I've come this far... This time, I must see the surface with my own eyes!
say:19:1410532017:1.source_cn: 不！都走到这一步了，这一次……我非得要亲眼看看地表的模样……

choice:12:0:1.text: He had the same symptoms as Feli...
choice:12:0:1.male: He had the same symptoms as Feli...
choice:12:0:1.female: He had the same symptoms as Feli...

say:21:1410532012:1.text: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!
say:21:1410532012:1.source_cn: 我不知道！但斐利尔的症状与那时候的阿利多很像！
say:21:1410532012:1.male: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!
say:21:1410532012:1.female: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!
